quests.instruction: Which animal makes its home on a farm?
quests.hint: Look for the animal with a curly tail and a round pink nose.
quests.explanation: Great job! The pig lives on a farm. You can spot it by a curly tail and a round pink nose.
quests.funFact: Did you know? they do not have sweat glands, so they roll in mud to cool down.

quests.instruction: Who is able to waddle and swim? Choose the right animal!
quests.hint: This animal lives on a farm near the water.
quests.explanation: Yes! The duck can waddle and swim. It has webbed feet made for paddling.
quests.funFact: Did you know? they use their webbed feet like paddles to swim efficiently.

quests.instruction: Listen closely! Who says "Moo"?
quests.hint: Think of an animal that lives in a green farm pasture.
quests.explanation: Yes! A cow says "Moo". It also has black and white spots and a gentle moo.
quests.funFact: Did you know? cows have almost 360-degree panoramic vision.

quests.instruction: A baby rooster has a special name. What is it called?
quests.hint: Baby animal names are often short and sweet, just like bright, colorful tail feathers.
quests.explanation: That's it! A baby rooster is called a chick. Grown-up roosters live in a farmyard at sunrise.
quests.funFact: A baby chicken is called a chick.

quests.instruction: One of these animals eats both plants and meat. Which one?
quests.hint: This animal lives on a muddy farm.
quests.explanation: Correct! The pig eats both plants and meat. It has a curly tail and a round pink nose.
quests.funFact: Did you know? pigs have an excellent sense of smell and can find truffles underground.

quests.instruction: A baby animal is called a "gosling". Which animal is its parent?
quests.hint: The grown-up animal lives on a farm pond.
quests.explanation: Correct! A baby goose is called a gosling. The goose has a long neck and orange webbed feet.
quests.funFact: Did you know? geese fly in a V-formation to save energy on long journeys.

quests.instruction: Which animal has short horns and a little beard?
quests.hint: This animal usually lives on a rocky farm hillside.
quests.explanation: That's right! The goat has short horns and a little beard. You can find it on a rocky farm hillside.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a baby goat is called a kid.

quests.instruction: Which animal's baby is called a "poult"?
quests.hint: The grown-up animal lives on a farm.
quests.explanation: Correct! A baby turkey is called a poult. The turkey has a fan of large tail feathers.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a male turkey's head can change color depending on his mood.

quests.instruction: One of these animals eats both plants and meat. Which one?
quests.hint: This animal lives in a cozy home as a loyal pet.
quests.explanation: Correct! The dog eats both plants and meat. It has a wagging tail and a wet nose.
quests.funFact: Did you know? they communicate using their tails, ears, and posture.

quests.instruction: Listen closely! Who says "Gobble"?
quests.hint: Think of an animal that lives on a farm.
quests.explanation: Yes! A turkey says "Gobble". It also has a fan of large tail feathers.
quests.funFact: Did you know? only male turkeys make the famous 'gobble' sound.

quests.instruction: Can you find the animal that only eats plants?
quests.hint: This animal lives on a farm pond.
quests.explanation: Correct! The goose only eats plants. It has a long neck and orange webbed feet.
quests.funFact: Did you know? they are highly loyal and will mate with the same partner for life.

quests.instruction: Which animal lives together in a "pack"?
quests.hint: This animal has a wagging tail and a wet nose.
quests.explanation: That's right! A group of dogs is called a pack. You can find them in a cozy home as a loyal pet.
quests.funFact: Did you know? dogs have been best friends with humans for thousands of years.

quests.instruction: Which animal says "Trumpet"?
quests.hint: Think of an animal that lives in the wild jungle.
quests.explanation: Yes! An elephant says "Trumpet". It also has a very long trunk and big flappy ears.
quests.funFact: Did you know? an elephant's trunk has over 40,000 muscles.

quests.instruction: Which animal lives together in a "pride"?
quests.hint: This animal has a big furry mane around the face.
quests.explanation: That's right! A group of lions is called a pride. You can find them prowling the wild savanna grasslands.
quests.funFact: Did you know? lions can sleep up to 20 hours a day.

quests.instruction: Which animal eats meat to survive?
quests.hint: This animal lives in a tree in a quiet forest.
quests.explanation: Correct! The owl eats meat to survive. It has huge round eyes and silent wings.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a group of owls is brilliantly called a parliament.

quests.instruction: Which animal can fly from flower to flower?
quests.hint: This animal lives buzzing around flowers in a garden.
quests.explanation: Yes! The bee can fly from flower to flower. It has black and yellow stripes and tiny wings.
quests.funFact: Did you know? bees perform a special 'waggle dance' to show others where flowers are.

quests.instruction: Which animal can trot and roll in the mud?
quests.hint: This animal lives on a muddy farm.
quests.explanation: Yes! The pig can trot and roll in the mud. It has a curly tail and a round pink nose.
quests.funFact: Did you know? they are very social animals and love to snuggle together to sleep.

quests.instruction: Which animal only eats plants?
quests.hint: This animal lives in the wild jungle.
quests.explanation: Correct! The elephant only eats plants. It has a very long trunk and big flappy ears.
quests.funFact: Did you know? they use their large ears to fan themselves and cool down.

quests.instruction: What do we call a group of goats?
quests.hint: Think about where goats usually live: on a rocky farm hillside.
quests.explanation: Yes! A group of goats is called a herd. They like to stay together on a rocky farm hillside.
quests.funFact: Did you know? moving in a herd provides safety from predators.

quests.instruction: A baby animal is called a "puppy". Which animal is its parent?
quests.hint: The grown-up animal lives in a cozy home as a loyal pet.
quests.explanation: Correct! A baby dog is called a puppy. The dog has a wagging tail and a wet nose.
quests.funFact: Fun fact: dogs have a sense of smell that is thousands of times better than ours.

quests.hint: Baby animal names are often short and sweet, just like a fan of large tail feathers.
quests.explanation: That's it! A baby turkey is called a poult. Grown-up turkeys live on a farm.
quests.funFact: A baby turkey is called a poult.

quests.instruction: A baby animal is called a "kid". Which animal is its parent?
quests.hint: The grown-up animal lives on a rocky farm hillside.
quests.explanation: Correct! A baby goat is called a kid. The goat has short horns and a little beard.
quests.funFact: Did you know? goats have rectangular pupils that give them excellent peripheral vision.

quests.instruction: Which animal's baby is called a "calf"?
quests.hint: The grown-up animal lives in a green farm pasture.
quests.explanation: Correct! A baby cow is called a calf. The cow has black and white spots and a gentle moo.
quests.funFact: Fun fact: cows have four digestive compartments in their stomach.

quests.instruction: Can you find the animal that lives in a garden?
quests.hint: Look for the animal with black and yellow stripes and tiny wings.
quests.explanation: Great job! The bee lives in a garden. You can spot it by black and yellow stripes and tiny wings.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a honey bee will visit up to 100 flowers during a single trip.

quests.instruction: What do we call a baby horse?
quests.hint: Baby animal names are often short and sweet, just like a long flowing mane and strong legs.
quests.explanation: That's it! A baby horse is called a foal. Grown-up horses live on a big open farm.

quests.instruction: Which animal can hop and swim?
quests.hint: This animal lives in a splashy pond.
quests.explanation: Yes! The frog can hop and swim. It has big round eyes and long jumping legs.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a group of frogs is called an army.

quests.explanation: Correct! The duck eats both plants and meat. It has webbed feet made for paddling.
